anatomy.caption: Anatomy of a cantilever snap fit, side view: the beam bends at the root, and the hook at its tip has an insertion (lead-in) face and a retention face.

deflection.caption: The beam bending away as the hook rides over the mating part's edge. Dashed is the start position, solid the deflected one, and the strain concentrates at the root.

moldability.caption: A hook that faces the pull direction, formed through a window in the wall, needs no slide. A hook facing inward on a closed wall needs a lifter.

rules.caption: The rules of thumb as ratios of the root thickness t.
